items.name: DNS OCIO Encoder
items.description: Convert OpenEXR image sequences into ProRes QuickTime movies with a color-managed workflow.
items.longDescription: A desktop utility concept built around OpenColorIO and FFmpeg for turning rendered EXR sequences into review-ready QuickTime movies. Release details and supported builds will be listed here when published.
requirements: Windows build and runtime requirements will be documented with the release.

items.name: Nuke Folder Scanner
items.description: A planned helper for locating render folders and image sequences across inconsistent naming conventions.
items.longDescription: Designed for production folders where render outputs may be named render, renders, HD_Renders, HDRenders or other common variants. The final feature set will be documented with a public release.

items.name: Python Production Kit
items.description: Reusable Python patterns and scripts for file handling, validation, logging and production automation.
items.longDescription: A planned collection of practical pipeline scripting examples: pathlib, structured logging, regular expressions, JSON/YAML configuration, CLI tools and tests.
requirements: Python version will be listed per release.

items.name: Render Folder Toolkit
items.description: Production-oriented helpers for finding render outputs and handling naming variations.
items.longDescription: An evolving set of utilities for discovering expected render folders, nested folders and sequence outputs in production directories.

items.name: Image Sequence Helpers
items.description: Planned helpers to inspect, prepare and move image sequences between production stages.
items.longDescription: A planned toolbox for sequence validation, frame range inspection and repeatable image preparation tasks.

items.name: Artist Workflow Kit
items.description: A growing idea for small artist-first utilities that remove repetitive production steps.
items.longDescription: A future collection of workflow helpers shaped around actual production pain points from compositing, lighting and CG pipelines.

items.name: Maya MEL Script Kit
items.description: A planned collection of Maya helpers for scene setup, lighting tasks and repeatable artist operations.
items.longDescription: A future set of MEL and Python utilities organized for Maya workflows. Each release will include supported Maya versions, installation notes and tested examples.
requirements: Maya version to be documented per release.

items.name: Blender Lighting Helpers
items.description: Planned Python utilities for organizing lighting scenes and recurring Blender setup tasks.
items.longDescription: A planned toolbox for lighting artists using Blender, with scene organization helpers and repeatable setup utilities.
requirements: Blender version to be documented per release.

items.name: Unreal Lighting Utilities
items.description: Planned helpers for Unreal lighting workflows, scene review and production setup.
items.longDescription: A planned collection of artist-facing helpers for Unreal Engine lighting pipelines. Compatibility and engine versions will be documented with each release.
requirements: Engine version to be documented per release.

items.name: Scene Utility Pack
items.description: Planned scene inspection and preparation utilities for day-to-day production workflows.
items.longDescription: A planned pack for scene checks, naming validation and lightweight production preparation.
requirements: Supported software versions to be documented.

items.name: Nuke Python Utilities
items.description: Planned compositing helpers for sequence discovery, node setup and workflow automation.
items.longDescription: A planned collection of Nuke Python tools with explicit supported Nuke versions, installation notes and test cases.
requirements: Nuke version to be documented per release.
